YOUR LANGUAGE SKILLS COULD BE THE START OF SOMETHING MORE.

Every day, interpreters help people understand one another, ask important questions, and be heard. Your language skills could be your first step toward a rewarding career in professional interpreting.

What is the CLS Interpreter Academy?

The CLS Interpreter Academy is a training program designed for bilingual individuals and early-career interpreters who want to build their professional interpreting skills, knowledge, and confidence.

  • Open worldwide
  • Remote opportunities
  • All languages welcome
  • Training provided
  • No previous interpreting experience required

Technical Requirements

  • 90% English proficiency
  • Stable internet connection
  • USB wired headset
  • Windows 10 or later or Mac

Whether you're bilingual and exploring interpreting for the first time or you're just starting your journey, this could be your opportunity to take the next step.

Interested in joining? Apply today.
One of our recruiters will contact you with more information about the program and next steps.

Explore the program and review the requirements.
